import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    if isinstance(entity_ids, (list, np.ndarray, pd.Series)):
        product_ids = list(entity_ids)
    else:
        product_ids = [entity_ids]

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # --- Отзывы: доступны только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ---
    rev_temp = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    rev_temp["positive"] = (rev_temp["review_score"] >= 4).astype(int)
    rev_agg = rev_temp.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        count_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        positive_count=("positive", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    rev_agg["positive_ratio"] = rev_agg["positive_count"] / rev_agg["count_reviews"]

    # --- Платежи: считаем известными к моменту покупки заказа (ts) ---
    pay_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        count_payments=("payment_value", "count"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Позиции по интересующим продуктам, покупки строго до seed_time ---
    items_filtered = items[items["product_id"].isin(product_ids)].copy()
    merged = items_filtered.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_status", "order_approved_at",
                "order_delivered_carrier_date", "order_delivered_customer_date"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    merged = merged[merged["ts"] < seed_time]

    if len(merged) > 0:
        merged = merged.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
        merged = merged.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

        # Доставка известна только если заказ уже доставлен ДО seed_time
        delivered_mask = merged["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & \
                         (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
        merged["delivery_days"] = np.where(
            delivered_mask,
            (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] - merged["ts"]).dt.days,
            np.nan
        )

        # Статусные признаки на момент seed_time
        merged["is_approved"] = (merged["order_approved_at"].notna() &
                                 (merged["order_approved_at"] < seed_time)).astype(int)
        merged["is_shipped"] = (merged["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna() &
                                (merged["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)).astype(int)
        merged["is_delivered"] = delivered_mask.astype(int)
        merged["days_since_purchase"] = (seed_time - merged["ts"]).dt.days

        # ---- Агрегаты по позициям ----
        pos_agg = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_items=("price", "count"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            min_price=("price", "min"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
            avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
            std_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "std"),
            frac_delivered=("is_delivered", "mean"),
            frac_shipped=("is_shipped", "mean"),
            frac_approved=("is_approved", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()

        # ---- Свежесть продаж: разные окна ----
        w30 = merged[merged["days_since_purchase"] <= 30].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        w90 = merged[merged["days_since_purchase"] <= 90].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        w180 = merged[merged["days_since_purchase"] <= 180].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        w365 = merged[merged["days_since_purchase"] <= 365].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()

        # ---- Признаки по уникальным заказам ----
        order_level = merged[["product_id", "order_id", "ts",
                              "total_payment", "count_payments", "avg_installments",
                              "avg_review", "count_reviews", "positive_ratio",
                              "days_since_purchase"]].drop_duplicates(
                                  subset=["product_id", "order_id"])

        order_agg = order_level.groupby("product_id").agg(
            num_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            total_payment_all=("total_payment", "sum"),
            avg_payment_per_order=("total_payment", "mean"),
            std_payment_per_order=("total_payment", "std"),
            avg_payments_per_order=("count_payments", "mean"),
            avg_install_mean=("avg_installments", "mean"),
            avg_review_score=("avg_review", "mean"),
            std_review_score=("avg_review", "std"),
            avg_review_count=("count_reviews", "mean"),
            avg_positive_ratio=("positive_ratio", "mean"),
            days_since_last=("ts", lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days),
            days_since_first=("ts", lambda x: (seed_time - x.min()).days),
            date_span=("ts", lambda x: (x.max() - x.min()).days),
        ).reset_index()

        # Тренд: доля продаж за последние 90 дней в общих продажах
        order_agg["recent_ratio_90"] = order_agg["product_id"].map(w90) / order_agg["num_orders"]
        # Числа продаж в окнах
        for name, w in [("orders_30", w30), ("orders_90", w90),
                        ("orders_180", w180), ("orders_365", w365)]:
            order_agg[name] = order_agg["product_id"].map(w)

        # Отзывы по заказам с этим продуктом, созданные до seed_time
        merged["has_review"] = merged["count_reviews"].notna().astype(int)
        rev_frac = merged.groupby("product_id")["has_review"].mean().rename("frac_orders_reviewed")

        features = pos_agg.merge(order_agg, on="product_id", how="outer")
        features = features.merge(rev_frac, on="product_id", how="outer")
    else:
        features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])

    features = features.set_index("product_id")
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(product_ids, name="product_id"))
    result = result.join(features, how="left")

    result["has_sales"] = result["num_orders"].notna().astype(int) if "num_orders" in result.columns else 0

    result = result.fillna(0).astype(float)
    result = result.loc[product_ids]
    return result
